title: Create and update Home widgets
description: The supported document schema, native and sandbox renderers, exact presentation route and delivery checks.
applicability: Use when asked to display a card, widget, custom view or controls in Home. An ordinary Task may need to return the document through its declared route to Home.

content.text: Attach and read the widget authoring reference through the declared selection. Discover the actual client tool and presentation address from your own grant and bound delivery context. A published document is separate from an installed extension.
